projects.title: Shamelessly Red
projects.description:
What actually happened in 1912?

No one could ever tell for sure why Isa Boletini, one of our Founding Fathers, was a day late after Albania declared its independence in 1912, until the big revelation one hundred years later.

He was getting beers to celebrate, according to Birra Tirana.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DrvJV1JvFnY

Broadcasted among a plethora of commercials during the 100 years of independence festivities, this ad not only stood out, but became a topic of a hot debate between more conservative guardians of history and their younger counterparts who didn't mind a joke once in…
